title: Man dead after being shot by RCMP on Cold Lake First Nations
article: The Alberta police watchdog has deployed to Cold Lake after a Mountie-involved shooting. A 52-year-old man was shot at a home by Mounties, on the Cold Lake First Nation, about 4:30 p.m. Thursday . Police were at the home to arrest someone when a confrontation broke out. The man was shot and then transported to Cold Lake hospital, where he was pronounced dead. The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team (ASIRT) is investigating. The team probes incidents involving the serious injury or the death of anyone, and serious or sensitive matters that may have resulted from the actions of a police officer. - Edmonton Sun
The story will be updated when more information is available.
